method: scripts/scout/local.mjs searched six Nairobi electronics stores per shopping line (hardware/shopping/parts), then every candidate below was opened and its title, price and stock text read on 2026-09-14. Exact spec matches only; near matches are listed with verdict rejected and the reason.

ktechnics.name: K-Technics
ktechnics.notes: Nairobi; stock text per product; M-Pesa

nerokas.name: Nerokas
nerokas.notes: Nairobi; prices on the search page, product pages show In Stock or a lead time

ardu.name: ArduinoTech Kenya
ardu.notes: Nairobi CBD; stock text per product

pixel.name: Pixel Electric
pixel.notes: every line checked on 2026-09-14 showed Sold Out, including the only Nairobi KQ-130F listing

espke.name: esp-ke
espke.notes: catalog JSON with stock counts; cells and tools, few modules

brightsource.name: Brightsource Kenya
brightsource.notes: Salama House, Wabera Street; same-day Nairobi dispatch

kentique.name: Kentique
kentique.notes: Tubman Road; stock and plug type not stated

tdk.name: TDK Solutions
tdk.notes: Kai Plaza, Tom Mboya Street; prices ex VAT

esp32-s3-devkitc-n16r8.title: ESP32-S3 Development Board ESP32-S3-WROOM-1 N16R8
esp32-s3-devkitc-n16r8.notes: 16 MB flash, 8 MB PSRAM, dual USB-C (CH340 UART plus native USB); WROOM-1 in the title, antenna type not spelled out on the page

esp32-s3-devkitc-n16r8.title: ESP32-S3 Development Board ESP32-S3-WROOM-1 N16R8
esp32-s3-devkitc-n16r8.notes: page states WROOM-1, integrated antenna, two USB-C; 1,500 dearer than K-Technics

esp32-s3-devkitc-n16r8.title: ESP32-S3 Dual Type-C Development Board
esp32-s3-devkitc-n16r8.notes: N16R8 and dual USB-C stated; module (WROOM-1 versus 1U) and antenna not stated, so ask before buying

ipex-sma-pigtail.title: Interface Cable SMA to U.FL
ipex-sma-pigtail.notes: 10 cm U.FL to SMA; the page does not say SMA female versus RP-SMA female, and the spec forbids RP-SMA

ipex-sma-pigtail.title: Antenna WiFi Pigtail Cable IPX to SMA Female
ipex-sma-pigtail.notes: specs say RP-SMA female, and sold out

kq-130f-plc-module.title: KQ-130F Power Cable Carrier Module- 135KHZ, 9600bps, +5V.
kq-130f-plc-module.notes: the only Nairobi listing; genuine KQ-130F pinout on the page; sold out on 2026-09-14, worth a restock call

antenna-868-sma.title: LoRa Antenna 868Mhz RF SMA Male
antenna-868-sma.notes: 868 MHz, SMA male; gain and length not published

antenna-868-sma.title: 3dBi Omnidirectional LoRa & LoRaWAN Antenna (868MHz / 915MHz)
antenna-868-sma.notes: page offers SMA male or RP-SMA male and 868 or 915 variants but publishes no price (0.00 in the store data); ask for the 868 SMA male price

homeplug-av-wifi-kit.title: TP-LINK TL-WPA4220KIT AV500 Powerline 300 M Wi-Fi Extender/Wi-Fi
homeplug-av-wifi-kit.notes: kit lists one TL-WPA4220 and one TL-PA4010, plug options EU, UK, US; price marked Exc. Tax so confirm the VAT-inclusive figure

homeplug-av-wifi-kit.title: TP-Link TL-WPA4220KIT 2-Port Powerline Adapter
homeplug-av-wifi-kit.notes: cheapest quoted, but stock and plug type are not on the page

hlk-pm01-5v-psu.title: HLK-PM01 HLK-PM03 HLK-PM12 AC-DC 220V to 5V/3.3V/12V mini power supply module
hlk-pm01-5v-psu.notes: pick the HLK-PM01 5 V variant; 600 mA, 2500 VAC isolation

hlk-pm01-5v-psu.title: 5V / 5W SMPS Module (Hi-Link)
hlk-pm01-5v-psu.notes: HLK-5M05, the accepted equivalent in the spec

hlk-pm01-5v-psu.title: HI-LINK HLK-PM01 3W AC-DC Power Supply Module (5V - PCB Mount)

tp4056-solar-charger.title: TP4056 1A Lithium Battery Charger Type-C with Protection
tp4056-solar-charger.notes: USB-C, DW01A plus FS8205A on the page

tp4056-solar-charger.title: TP4056 / TC4056A Lithium Battery Charger and Protection Module
tp4056-solar-charger.notes: DW01A and FS8205A stated, USB connector type not stated

18650-holder.title: 1-Cell 18650 Battery Holder with Pre-Attached Wire Leads

18650-cell.title: 18650 Lithium Ion Battery INR 3.7V Cell (2600mAh)
18650-cell.notes: no cell line exists in parts/ because cells cannot ship; listing price from the search page, brand not stated

solar-panel-6v-2w.title: 3W 6V 500mA Mini Solar Panel
solar-panel-6v-2w.notes: 6 V 3 W, 145 mm square; leads versus bare pads not stated

solar-panel-6v-2w.title: Solar Cell 6V 330mA
solar-panel-6v-2w.notes: 6 V 2 W, 136 by 110 mm; leads not stated

soil-moisture-capacitive-v2.title: Analog Capacitive Soil Moisture Sensor Corrosion Resistant
soil-moisture-capacitive-v2.notes: 3.3 to 5.5 V, analogue out, PH2.0-3P lead

temp-humidity-sensor.title: AHT20 I2C temperature and humidity sensor module
temp-humidity-sensor.notes: the spec prefers the AHT20 when cheaper

temp-humidity-sensor.title: DHT22 AM2302 Digital Temperature and Humidity Sensor Module
DHT22 AM2302 Temperature Humidity Sensor
temp-humidity-sensor.notes: bare sensor or module not stated

esp32-c3-supermini.title: ESP32C3 PRO MINI development board type C
esp32-c3-supermini.notes: 22.5 by 18 mm, USB-C, boot and reset, 4 MB flash: the SuperMini footprint under another name; rejected under the exact-name rule

usb-ttl-ch340.title: CP2102 USB 2.0 to TTL UART Module 6Pin Serial Converter STC Replace FT232 Adapter Module 3.3V/5V Power
usb-ttl-ch340.notes: 3.3 V and 5 V power pins, USB-A plug

usb-ttl-ch340.title: CP2102 USB Micro USB to UART TTL Serial Converter Module
usb-ttl-ch340.notes: 3.3 V logic only, no 5 V selector

usb-ttl-ch340.title: CH340 module USB to TTL CH340G
usb-ttl-ch340.notes: no description on the page; selector unknown

breadboard-jumpers.title: Breadboard 830 Point PCB Board MB-102 MB102
Male-Male, Male-Female and Female-Female jumper wires, 40 pcs 20 cm each
breadboard-jumpers.notes: three packs at 150 make the 120 piece set; the M-F and F-F packs are sibling listings

usb-c-otg-adapter.title: USB OTG Cable
usb-c-otg-adapter.notes: micro-A, not USB-C; buy the USB-C OTG adapter at any phone accessories shop
